title: Enforced label canonicalizer and quantile stabilizer for inference KPIs
creator: Aisha Mehra
description:
Problem: We ingest hybrid telemetry from edge proxies (OTLP) and Prometheus exporters, and have inconsistent label namespaces, unstable quantile summaries, and missing inference-specific attributes (kv_cache_hit, model_variant, cold_start_reason). This causes noisy SLOs and frequent false-positive regression alerts.

Goal: Implement a canonicalization and enrichment stage in the metrics ingestion pipeline that: (1) reconciles label aliases across OTLP and Prometheus sources, (2) applies deterministic low-cardinality mappings for high-variance fields (prompt_prefix, user_agent), (3) stabilizes quantile calculation across transient sampling changes via t-digest smoothing and exemplar anchoring, and (4) injects trace/span links and KV-cache hit annotations into metric envelopes so dashboards and SLI backfills can correlate per-request latency and error KPIs with traces and model behavior.
acceptance_criteria: Canonicalizer applies tenant-aware alias map and reduces effective cardinality of prompt_prefix and route labels to <= 128 unique keys per tenant for 99th percentile queries
OTLP and Prom scrape paths produce aligned metric names and a shared attribute namespace (model_variant, kv_cache_hit, cold_start) documented in the schema registry
Quantile stabilizer produces consistent p50/p95/p99 results across 24h windows with variance reduction >= 30% compared to current sampling baseline in synthetic workload
Exemplars include deterministic exemplar_id linked to trace_id/span_id and persisted for 7 days for backfill correlation
Dashboard panels (latency, errors, kv_cache_hit rate, model_variant rollups) updated with new labels and show correct historical continuity after a migration shim
tasks: Design alias map format and tenant merge rules (Confluence draft)
Implement canonicalizer stage as a lightweight stream transform in the telemetry ingest service (Go)
Add deterministic hashing + bucket mapping for high-cardinality label values
Integrate t-digest quantile stabilizer library and expose smoothing config per-tenant
Emit exemplar metadata with trace/span linkage; update OTLP span enrichment hook
Create migration shim for historical Prometheus metrics to map prior label variants to canonical labels
Add e2e tests with synthetic traffic to validate variance reduction and cardinality bounds
Update Grafana dashboards and alert rules; create runbook entries for troubleshooting
comments: 2025-02-12 Aisha Mehra: Created ticket after oncall incident where p99 latency alerts fired due to a sudden spike in prompt_prefix cardinality from a customer experiment.
2025-02-14 Luca Fernandez: PoC canonicalizer implemented; needs integration tests. PoC reduces unique prompt_prefix values from ~12k to ~64 with tenant remapping rules.

2025-02-16 Reviewer (SRE Lead - Maria Gomez): Suggested we keep a reversible alias table for debugging — solution: store original value in ephemeral metadata field 'orig_label_sample' only for 1% sampled metrics.
2025-02-18 Data Science (Ravi Patel): Run synthetic stability benchmark against t-digest smoothing; initial results show 37% variance reduction on p99 for bursty workloads.
2025-02-20 Luca Fernandez: Implemented exemplar_id linking and added unit tests for trace/span correlation. Opening PR for review. Next: dashboard migration and rollout plan.
notes: Edge proxies will tag kv_cache_hit as boolean string; canonicalizer should normalize to the metric attribute kv_cache_hit: 'hit'|'miss'
We need to coordinate with Dedicated team to ensure alias map is available in private deployments (export via config sync)
Consider adding a per-tenant budgeted cardinality meter to alert when incoming distinct keys approach mapping limit
